name: contract-expectation-diagnostics
goal: Preserve the original error when an authored example unexpectedly fails.

evidence: An invalid tested revision caused the audio method case to report only Example unexpectedly failed; its original validation error was absent.
The existing example-initialized case asserted only a generic failure message, so it never required the unexpected error message or cause to survive.
Committed test a819be0cd8 failed in c821694fe96f because the original error message and cause were missing.
f3a574274a preserves the unexpected thrown value and message; 73ea1d2d48 simplifies the formatter.
Unchanged case passed at 73ea1d2d48 in 78b689e81bef; mutant 4a3d35249b36 failed and restored 22c75953df74 passed.
